Lines: You don't look like a ghost to me.
It's what they call us. Ghosts.
Actually, it's also what they call *me*. My name is Ghost.
Wait. What are you doing here?
I'm... essentially looking for deceased individuals capable of wielding <c=ffffff>Light</c> and becoming <c=ffffff>Guardians</c>.
Putting all the Light and Guardian nonsense aside, I'm afraid none of the crew are dead.
Uhhh... given the time loop shenanigans... you could say that?
